headline: The New York Times put five songwriters up against an AI and let readers judge who wrote the better songs.
score_reason: Playful, well-made demo from a major outlet, but the original was unreadable here and the relayed detail is thin.
importance_line: Listeners get a side-by-side test of human and machine songwriting that The Verge says the humans win easily; the doubt is that this verdict is one Verge writer's opinion of the Times piece.
summary: The New York Times reports, as relayed by The Verge, that it staged a songwriting contest between five musicians and an AI and documented both sides' writing process in diary form. The Verge's Terrence O'Brien judges that it is "not much of a competition" because the AI songs are easy to pick out side by side, which he says shows how little effort AI music involves.
notes: NYT blocked (403); text read at https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1004401/the-new-york-times-pitted-five-musicians-against-an-ai-in-a-songwriting-competition, a short blurb.
